segments.name: pharmaceuticals
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products and multi-specific immune therapies for growth disorders, kidney disease, cancer and infectious diseases.
segments.evidence: The pharmaceutical segment consists of the pharmaceutical operations we operate in Chile, Mexico, Ireland, Israel, Spain, Ecuador, France, the United States, and our global pharmaceutical research and development operations.

segments.name: diagnostics
segments.description: Operates clinical laboratory testing services including specialty urology and women's health testing for patients and providers.
segments.evidence: The diagnostics segment primarily consists of the clinical laboratory operations of BioReference.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by manufacturing and selling pharmaceutical products and by performing clinical laboratory testing services.
revenueModel.evidence: Through our pharmaceutical business, we manufacture and sell Rayaldee , a U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") approved treatment for secondary hyperparathyroidism ("SHPT") in adults with stage 3 or 4 chronic kidney disease ("CKD") and vitamin D insufficiency.

changes.text: In 2024 and 2025 the company divested non-core laboratory assets, including clinical diagnostics, reproductive health, women's health and oncology diagnostics businesses.
changes.evidence: In 2024 and 2025, we completed two separate divestitures of non-core laboratory assets for total aggregate consideration of up to $462.5 million, including approximately $32.5 million in potential earnout consideration.
